const axios = require('axios')
const qs = require('querystring')

async function ytmp3(url) {
  try {
    if (!url) {
      return {
        code: 400,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        message: 'Masukkan URL YouTube-nya bang'
      }
    }

    const payload = qs.stringify({ url })

    const headers = {
      'content-type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
      origin: 'https://www.videodowns.com'
    }

    const res = await axios.post(
      'https://www.videodowns.com/youtube-video-downloader.php?action=get_info',
      payload,
      { headers }
    )

    const data = res.data || {}
    const formats = data.formats || {}

    const audio = formats.audio?.ext
      ? \`https://www.videodowns.com/youtube-video-downloader.php?download=1&url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}&format=audio\`
      : null

    return {
      code: 200,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      data: {
        title: data.info?.title || null,
        channel: data.info?.channel || data.info?.author || null,
        thumbnail: data.thumbnail || null,
        audio
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      code: 500,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      message: e?.response?.data || e?.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan'
    }
  }
}
